name: NAATTILE SCENE — ഇത് കേരളമാണ്! (Kizhakkumpuram 3D Open World)
description: Explore an authentic Kerala open world with a massive 12-district map spanning from Northern Highland Hills and Teak Forests down to Southern Coastline and Lighthouse Beach, featuring arterial highways, living traffic (Ambassadors, lorries, ambulances, police jeeps, scooters, cycles), village fauna (grazing cows, street dogs, chickens), KSRTC buses, and Babu's auto rickshaw.
